mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO virtual_wallet (wallet_id, user_id, balance, frozen_amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{userId}, #{balance}, #{frozenAmount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE virtual_wallet SET frozen_amount = GREATEST(0, frozen_amount - #{amount}), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE virtual_wallet SET balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
